npz: Compare decoded field sets, exact dtype/shape and numpy.array_equal(equal_nan=True) for numeric arrays. Container bytes and timestamps are not compared.
csv: Compare every parsed cell and row order, ignoring transport newline differences only.
json: Compare parsed dictionaries/lists/numbers exactly after removing the explicit volatile keys below; no fitted values, denominators, source hashes or scientific lag/window fields are removed.
hash_key_exclusion_condition: The corresponding decoded arrays/scientific data must have their own exact comparison; never substitute a removed container hash for verifying contents.
provenance_hash_aliases: Only exact new->original metadata hashes recorded by the public-projection adapter may normalize sha256-suffixed provenance fields. Numerical source hashes, arrays, observations, fitted values and table cells are not relaxed.
runtime_created_run_manifest: run_manifest_sha256 is NOT globally volatile. Before a specific alias is issued, both manifests must authenticate their own complete output inventories; every paired file is compared by exact decoded arrays/CSV cells/normalized scientific JSON, path sets and all other non-runtime manifest fields must match. A changed numeric value or contract prevents the alias. The first QA mismatch and conditional-comparison audit are preserved.
large_core: Recompute36 KD/Node cases with original numerical implementations and compare complete selected parent/proximity arrays and summary against retained full references. Exhaustive reruns and timing studies are optional.
gem_history: Verify complete retained memberships/decisions/pairs/input hashes and original source pin/license; recompute historical association counts and ten fixed time-shift results. Do not claim the engine itself was newly run.
javascript: Owned JS parent indices exact and recorded score absolute tolerance at most1e-10, masks/nonfinite cases explicit. Preserve the original scientific checks; do not relax after discrepancy.
benchmarks: Wall times, CPU times, dates, absolute runtime paths, RSS and OS/browser scheduling are observations of a new run; no historical equality claim.
runtime_scope: First target is the observed pinned Windows x64 environment. No universal IEEE/libm, MATLAB or POSIX memory-equivalence guarantee.
